arguments.name: Morning workspace status
arguments.prompt:
Morning workspace status check. Perform the following:

1. List all files and directories under /workspace recursively.
2. Note the total count of files and directories.
3. Deliver a concise summary to the Slack DM (target_id: slack:qa-trace-dm) using builtin__outbound_deliver with that target_id.
4. Deliver the same summary to the Telegram DM (target_id: telegram:qa-trace-dm) using builtin__outbound_deliver with that target_id.

The summary should include:
- Current timestamp (in UTC)
- Number of files and directories
- List of top-level items
- Any notable changes if the workspace has been modified since the last run (note: each run has no memory of prior runs, so just report what's there)

Format it cleanly in a short message suitable for both Slack and Telegram.
